record.paper_title: Some open problems on the analysis of the Cauchy-Fueter system in several variables
record.original_question: Develop a theory of regular functions of several octonion variables; compute the flabby dimension of the resulting sheaf of octonionic regular functions; and construct an analogue of the Moisil-Theodoresco operator in that octonionic setting. The source frames this as a continuation of earlier work on octonionic regular functions and the Cauchy-Fueter-Cayley operator.

evidence.quote: Problem: Develop such a theory, compute the flabby dimension of the sheaf of octonionic regular functions, and construct an analogue of the Moisil-Theodoresco operator.
it may be interesting to utilize our approach to develop a theory of regular functions of several octonion variables.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{O}$ denote the algebra of octonions, a real non-associative normed division algebra of dimension $8$ with standard basis $\{e_0=1,e_1,\dots,e_7\}$. A smooth function $f:\mathbb{R}^8\cong\mathbb{O}\to\mathbb{O}$ is called (left) octonionic regular if it lies in the kernel of the Cauchy–Fueter–Cayley operator
$$D = \sum_{i=0}^{7} e_i\,\partial_{x_i}.$$
For $n\ge 2$, consider functions $f:\mathbb{O}^n\to\mathbb{O}$ of several octonion variables and the system $D_1 f = \cdots = D_n f = 0$, where $D_k$ is the Cauchy–Fueter–Cayley operator applied to the $k$-th octonion variable.

(a) Develop a coherent theory of regular functions of several octonion variables based on the overdetermined system above (define an appropriate sheaf $\mathcal{R}$ of such regular functions on $\mathbb{O}^n$ and establish its basic homological/analytic properties).

(b) Compute the flabby dimension of the sheaf $\mathcal{R}$, i.e., the smallest integer $d\ge 0$ such that $\mathcal{R}$ admits a resolution of length $d$ by flabby sheaves.

(c) Construct an analogue of the Moisil–Theodoresco operator in this several-variable octonionic setting and identify regular functions as solutions of the corresponding first-order system.
artifact.category_tag: octonionic regular functions in several variables
artifact.status_search_result: Work on octonionic analysis in several variables exists (e.g., integral representation theorems, Bochner–Martinelli formulas, and a Moisil–Teodorescu-type characterization in one variable), and there is research on the structure of octonion regular functions. However, no published source clearly computes the flabby dimension of the sheaf of regular functions of several octonion variables in the sense requested, so the problem appears to be only partially addressed.

status_evidence.title: Octonion Analysis of Several Variables
status_evidence.snippet: Functions of several octonion variables are investigated; integral representation theorems are proved and used to study solutions of dbar-equations.
status_evidence.claim: Several-variable octonionic function theory has been partially developed.

status_evidence.title: On the Structure of Octonion Regular Functions
status_evidence.snippet: A function f:R^8 -> O is left regular iff it satisfies a Moisil–Teodorescu type system.
status_evidence.claim: A Moisil–Teodorescu analogue is known in one octonion variable, but the multi-variable analogue and flabby dimension remain unsettled.
